verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's API reference offers code samples across many client libraries, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and a first-party Postman collection, so examples can be run against a self-serve Sandbox workspace. There is no evidence of an in-browser interactive console or 'try it' widget; running examples needs Postman or an SDK. The OpenAPI probe 404s only hit JSON candidate paths and do not contradict the documented YAML download. Missing for 10: an in-docs interactive request explorer, evidence that examples run directly from the reference page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
